title.narrative: Scaling Up Prevention, Oversight, Reach and Treatment of Tuberculosis in Zimbabwe (SUPPORT-TB Activity)

description.narrative: (Zimbabwe): USAID's Scaling Up Prevention, Oversight, Reach and Treatment of Tuberculosis in Zimbabwe (SUPPORT-TB) Activity is implemented by a consortium of local organizations that supports the national TB program (NTP) to develop and implement policies, strategies, and services for TB prevention, diagnosis, care, treatment, and support, and to create an enabling environment for TB control in Zimbabwe. ..With FY 2024 funds, the activity will provide technical assistance and direct service delivery for comprehensive implementation of national TB guidelines, procedures, and other standards of practice. This support boosts health facilities to continuously improve and maintain the quality of TB services. Specifically, the mechanism will:.Assist with implementation of the national TB guidelines..Scale up of TB services to a total of 30 districts..Engage additional human resources for health (HRH) including nurses and microscopists at high volume facilities to increase TB service provision..Integrate TB screening and diagnostic services into existing outreach activities within communities that are at high risk of TB infection..Develop the capacity of existing HIV community level cadres to offer TB services..Use existing systems for tracking and tracing HIV clients to follow up on TB contacts and defaulters..Improve TB case-finding from all sources..Build the capacity of NTP personnel on effective program management and data use..Provide TB/HIV clinical services in health facilities and in communities..Support service delivery platforms to improve the quality of TB services..Document the burden of multidrug-resistant TB (MDR-TB)..Improve the management of MDR-TB..Control silico-TB among high-risk populations such as artisanal miners...These interventions will result in a sustained reduction in new TB cases, increased identification of TB infected individuals, and increased TB treatment success....
